prerequisites: Build the integrated controller and Linux amd64 Lambda telemetry helper explicitly.
Install Terraform 1.15.9, signed/cached AWS provider6.68.0, Python dependencies, Docker, OpenSSL and dig.
Prepare the exact existing Lambda Python3.12 and Ubuntu disk-storage images named in run.py. No automatic pulls.

The runtime controller binds 0.0.0.0 for container callbacks. Use an isolated trusted host; restrict port14703. Control and request clients use trusted loopback HTTPS. DNS is explicit127.0.0.1:15703; no host DNS edits.
